messages:
shilpa: Heads-up — Canary Watchdog policy is changing and we're running a short dry-run failover to validate detection + mitigations. Please scan and ack if you have conflicts.

shilpa: Policy change TL;DR:
- New 'watchdog' rule: sustained degradation (latency or 5xx) for 6m triggers automatic canary hold + incident open.
- We previously relied on 10m manual detection; this lowers time-to-detect to reduce blast radius.
- No auto-global rollback: holds only stop canary promotions and surface an incident for SRE review.
- Doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-watchdog (please review)

dan: When's the dry-run?

shilpa: Wed Jun 10 2026 23:00-23:45 UTC. Scope: dry-route failover in us-west-2 canaries, plus a light token-heavy replay to force KV cold-starts. Expected: no customer downtime but canary latency spikes and transient 5xxs possible.

mike: Monitoring plan: I'll put up a short-lived dashboard with p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, kv-miss-rate, and route-fallback counts. Pager thresholds: 5xx > 12% for 4m OR p99 > 1.5s for 6m.

beth: I'll update support playbooks and draft a one-paragraph note for enterprise account owners. Also avoiding promotions from 22:30-00:30 UTC that night.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Canary Watchdog dry-run + failover" Wed Jun 10 23:00-23:45 UTC — invites: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime, #support.

shilpa: Pre-checks to complete before the window:
- confirm canary pool topology and tags
- ensure promo webhooks are disabled 22:30-00:30 UTC
- verify runbook access and playbook links in PagerDuty incident

shilpa: Quick abort snippets (kept here for fast copy):
```
# stop replay fanout
kubectl scale deploy/replay -n stress --replicas=0
# freeze canary routing
infractl routing set-weight --pool canary --weight 0
# clear temp warmups
infractl kvcache set-retention --pool canary --seconds 300
```

dan: Question — is the watchdog sensitivity adjustable per-customer? We shouldn't noisy-page on small internal regressions for big-paying customers.

mike: Currently it's per-pool. We can add tenant exemptions, but not in this rollout. We'll note for follow-up.

beth: Acked — I'll coordinate customer exemptions if a high-risk account overlaps.

ops-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-canary-watchdog-1852500000

shilpa: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've read and can be on-call or reachable. If you see any scheduling conflicts, reply here.

dan: :white_check_mark: I'll be on rotation that night.

mike: :white_check_mark: Dashboard links will land 30m prior.

beth: :white_check_mark: I'll hold off promotions and post the enterprise note.

shilpa: Thanks everyone — will post final checklist 1h before start.
